name: gemini
description: Use Gemini from Codex to research, augment knowledge, and search with citations.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate research and knowledge-base tasks to Gemini, with Google Search grounding.
interface.longDescription: Bring Google Gemini (long context + Search grounding) into Codex as a research assistant. Three modes: ask (Q&A with sources), research (deep research → markdown draft), augment (delta-style updates to existing docs). Built for cross-border e-commerce / Amazon workflows — prompts preserve domain terminology (ACOS, ASIN, ROAS, BSR, AMC) and enforce source citations. Pairs with codex's own deep-code abilities: codex = depth × code, gemini = breadth × knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Research the latest Amazon SP advertising algorithm changes
Find recent industry news about cross-border e-commerce AI agents
